description.en: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness. Add this URL in Plugins > Discover to install them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件集合。在 插件 → 发现 中添加此地址即可安装。

description.en: Adds an HTTP proxy preference to Settings > General: direct, follow the system proxy (Windows WinINET / macOS scutil, PAC included), or a custom proxy URL. Applied to models, MCP, web fetch and command tools immediately, without restarting the Harness.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用设置 中增加 HTTP 代理选项：直连、跟随系统代理（Windows WinINET / macOS scutil，支持 PAC）或自定义代理。模型、MCP、网页抓取与命令工具立即生效，无需重启 Harness。
